meta.canonical_id_policy: Stable geo IDs reuse the existing registry. Composite researched regions are geographic_area unless an administrative status is independently established.

sources.publisher: Expedition South East project research layer
used_for: verified locality relations where canonical locality IDs already exist

rules.parentage: No composite expedition region is promoted to province/state/district without independent evidence.
rules.route_hubs: Composite route hubs remain logistics metadata unless a real locality already has its own canonical geo ID.
rules.object_visibility: Every existing object must be reachable from at least one formal country geography node.
rules.cards: Object card payloads are not edited in this stage.
